name: Deere Repair Services Antitrust Litigation Settlement
summary: $99 million settlement resolving antitrust claims that John Deere monopolized repair services for its large agricultural equipment. Class members who paid for repairs can claim a pro rata share of the fund.

eligibilityQuestions.text: Did you or your farm business pay John Deere, or an authorized Deere dealer, for diagnosis, maintenance, or repair of Deere Large Agricultural Equipment (6000/7000/8000/9000 series tractors, combines, harvesters, etc.) between January 10, 2018 and May 18, 2026?
Did you pay for that repair yourself or under an extended warranty you purchased (i.e. not a repair covered under Deere's original factory warranty)?

claimFields.label: Full legal name or farm business name
Notice ID from your settlement notice (optional — without one, the official site requires you to attach documentation for each repair claimed)
